content: faster-whisper (CTranslate2) beats whisper.cpp on NVIDIA GPUs: ~12x realtime large-v3 int8 on RTX4070 (~2.5GB VRAM), ~8x on RTX3060. whisper.cpp better for pure-CPU / Apple Silicon / tiny-footprint. large-v3 ~7.4% WER on mixed English benchmarks; Russian is a high-resource Whisper language (good but no single canonical RU WER number, generally ~10-15% depending on domain/noise). CPU-only large-v3 cannot hit realtime; int8/int4 quant needed. Self-host feasible on a single GPU box for on-prem sovereignty.
